messages.author: d240abad3179bacb
messages.subject: Erreur : Command failed (65535)
parts:
I'm trying to install the shiny apps package from github, but I keep getting this error. I can't find any documentation on this error code.

> devtools::install_github("rstudio/shinyapps")
Installing github repo shinyapps/master from rstudio
Downloading shinyapps.zip from https://github.com/rstudio/shinyapps/archive/master.zip
Installing package from C:\Users\VIADUC~1\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpK236IX/shinyapps.zip
Installing shinyapps
"C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-215~1.3/bin/x64/R" --vanilla CMD INSTALL  \
  "C:\Users\viaduc450\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpK236IX\devtools904268d6c2b\shinyapps-master"  \
  --library="C:/Users/viaduc450/Documents/R/win-library/2.15" --install-tests 

Erreur : Command failed (65535)


Locale information: 

> Sys.getlocale()
LC_COLLATE=English_United States.1252;
LC_CTYPE=English_United States.1252;
LC_MONETARY=English_United States.1252;
LC_NUMERIC=C;LC_TIME=English_United States.1252

If works on my American Rstudio, but not my French Rstudio. Note: I reset all the Sys.locale from France to the US and this still doesn't work.


Thanks,
Kristine
